description:
Search Sentry profiles: transaction and continuous profile results, profile IDs, and profiled transactions. Use to find profiles to inspect.

`query` is natural language (preferred) or Sentry search syntax; a configured agent translates it into query, fields, and sort.

Use get_profile or get_profile_details on a result for flamegraph and hotspot analysis.

<examples>
search_profiles(organizationSlug='my-org', query='recent profiles for the /checkout transaction')
</examples>

<hints>
- name/otherName notation means <organizationSlug>/<projectSlug>; parse it directly, don't call find_organizations/find_projects.
- Natural language is usually enough. Only pass fields/sort when you need exact columns or ordering.
</hints>

fields.description: Fields to return. If not specified, uses sensible defaults. Include aggregate functions like count(), avg() for statistics.

includeExplanation.description: Include explanation of how the query was translated or repaired

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100)

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

period.description: Relative time window, such as `30m`, `1h`, `24h`, `7d`, or `90d`. Controls which records fall within the search window.

anyOf.description: The project's slug. You can find a list of existing projects in an organization using the `find_projects()` tool.

query.description: What to find, in natural language (preferred) or Sentry search syntax. Include environment, release, or other filters here.

anyOf.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'. For self-hosted Sentry installations, this parameter is usually not needed and should be omitted. You can find the correct regionUrl from the organization details using the `find_organizations()` tool.

sort.description: Sort field (prefix with - for descending). Defaults to -timestamp. Use -count() for aggregations.

name: search_profiles

values.description: The requested fields, keyed by field name.

buckets.description: The most recent buckets, oldest first.

incomplete.description: Data is still arriving, so the value may rise.

outsideRetention.description: Starts before the retention window, so older data is missing and the value will not change.

interval.description: Bucket size; null when Sentry chose it for the range.

peak.description: Highest bucket that is no longer receiving data.

total.description: Sum of all buckets; null for non-additive aggregates.

title: Search Profiles
